decision_maker: Caravan physician-priest, responsible for the spiritual and physical health of the clan.
action: Expose a group of captive raiders to the mutated dust-borne plague so their immune reactions can be harvested for a vaccine.
act_victims: Five captured raiders, unrelated to the caravan, already condemned to death by clan law.
default_victims: The entire caravan of 400 people, including children and elders, who will die when the plague reaches them.

title: The Industrial Orphanage
setting: 19th century, an industrial city in England, where an orphanage is struck by a mysterious fever.
decision_maker: Orphanage matron, a former nurse.
action: Inoculate five orphan children with material from a dead child to create a vaccine for the wealthy patrons of the orphanage.
act_victims: Five orphan children, ages 4–12, who live at the orphanage.
default_victims: The orphanage's 100 children and the 50 wealthy patrons who fund it.

title: The Nomad's Curse
setting: Early modern, a nomadic caravan in the Middle Eastern deserts, fleeing a plague outbreak.
decision_maker: Tribal shaman, responsible for the spiritual and physical well-being of the tribe.
action: Perform a ritual that involves infecting three captured bandits with the plague to produce a protective charm for the tribe's children.
act_victims: Three captured bandits, unrelated to the tribe, who attacked the caravan.
default_victims: The tribe's 200 members, especially the 50 children, who will die if the plague reaches them.

title: The Orbital Ring's Quarantine
setting: Far future, a space station orbiting a gas giant, serving as a waypoint for colony ships.
decision_maker: Station medical director, an AI-augmented human with absolute authority in health emergencies.
action: Expose a group of stowaway refugees to a genetically engineered virus so their antibodies can be harvested to protect the station's permanent crew.
act_victims: Seven stowaway refugees, including two children, who boarded without permission.
default_victims: The station's 1,200 permanent residents and the crews of three docked colony ships.

title: The Research Base's Dilemma
setting: Far future, an underwater research base studying a deadly virus in the Mariana Trench.
decision_maker: Base commander, a marine biologist.
action: Expose two crew members to the virus to develop a vaccine for the rest of the base.
act_victims: Two crew members, including the commander's spouse.
default_victims: The base's 30 crew members, who will die if the virus spreads.

title: The Silk Road's Fever
setting: 19th century, a caravan crossing the Taklamakan Desert, carrying silk and medicines.
decision_maker: Caravan master, responsible for the cargo, camels, and men.
action: Force three travelers from a plague-stricken village to breathe concentrated fever vapors so their blood can be used to treat the caravan leader's son.
act_victims: Three travelers, unrelated to the caravan, who joined at the last oasis.
default_victims: The caravan leader's young son, who will die of the fever within days.

title: The Space Station's Last Hope
setting: Far future, a deep-space research station studying a mysterious alien pathogen.
decision_maker: Station commander, a scientist with a military background.
action: Deliberately infect three crew members with the alien pathogen to study its effects and develop a cure for the rest of the station.
act_victims: Three crew members, including the commander's best friend, selected by lottery.
default_victims: The station's 150 crew members, who will all die if the pathogen escapes containment.

title: The War Zone's Field Hospital
setting: War zone, a besieged city in a 19th-century conflict, where a field hospital operates in a church basement.
decision_maker: Army surgeon, exhausted and low on supplies.
action: Infect five enemy prisoners of war with gangrene to produce a serum for the wounded soldiers of his own army.
act_victims: Five enemy prisoners of war, captured that morning, already wounded.
default_victims: Forty wounded soldiers of the decision-maker's army, including his own brother.

title: The War Zone's Vaccine
setting: War zone, a 19th-century battlefield where a makeshift laboratory operates in a tent.
decision_maker: Military doctor, a woman disguised as a man to serve.
action: Infect four wounded enemy soldiers with a modified smallpox virus to produce a vaccine for her own troops.
act_victims: Four wounded enemy soldiers, captured and unconscious.
default_victims: Two hundred soldiers of her army, including her younger brother.

title: The Arctic Bunker
setting: Far future, a subterranean bunker in the Arctic built to withstand a nuclear winter. A genetic disorder is causing sterility in the population.
decision_maker: The bunker's geneticist, who is also the father of a sterile teenager.
action: Irradiate a group of young adults, including his own child, to induce mutations that might lead to a cure for the sterility, with a high risk of cancer and death.
act_victims: Ten young adults, aged 18-25, including the geneticist's child.
default_victims: The entire bunker population, which will die out within a generation if sterility is not cured.

title: The Arctic Expedition
setting: 1960s, a remote Arctic research station during the Cold War. A team of scientists is stranded and discovers a new disease in the ice.
decision_maker: The expedition's medical officer, a young woman who is the only one with medical training.
action: Infect a group of Inuit hunters who have come to trade, including a teenager, with the ancient disease to study its effects and develop a treatment before it spreads to the station.
act_victims: Four Inuit hunters, aged 16-50, from a nearby village.
default_victims: The station's crew of twenty, and potentially the nearby village, if the disease spreads.

title: The Arctic Seed Vault
setting: Far future, an Arctic research station built into a glacier. A global catastrophe has left a small group of scientists as the only hope for humanity.
decision_maker: The station's lead geneticist, who is also a mother of two young children.
action: Irradiate a group of healthy but genetically diverse volunteers, including teenagers, to study radiation resistance and develop a gene therapy for the remaining population.
act_victims: Eight teenagers, aged 14-17, who volunteered out of desperation.
default_victims: The entire human population of the station, including the geneticist's children, if the gene therapy is not developed.

title: The Desert Convoy
setting: Present day, a vast desert region controlled by a repressive regime. A dissident scientist runs a secret clinic in a cave for refugees.
decision_maker: A field medic and former army nurse who now leads the clinic.
action: Inject a group of captured enemy soldiers with an experimental antidote that requires live human testing to confirm its efficacy against a bioweapon the regime is believed to be developing.
act_victims: Five enemy soldiers, aged 19-22, captured during a skirmish.
default_victims: Thousands of civilians in the region, including the medic's own refugee community.

title: The Desert Nomads
setting: Present day, a desert region where a nomadic tribe has been isolated for centuries. A pharmaceutical company discovers a unique genetic trait in the tribe that could cure a global disease.
decision_maker: A tribal elder who is also a healer and has seen the suffering of his people from the disease.
action: Subject a group of young tribe members, including his own grandchildren, to a risky experimental procedure that involves infecting them with a weakened form of the disease to harvest antibodies.
act_victims: Six young tribe members, aged 12-18, including the elder's grandchildren.
default_victims: Millions worldwide, including many in the tribe, who will die from the disease if a cure is not found.

title: The Desert Refugee Camp
setting: Present day, a sprawling refugee camp in a desert region. An outbreak of a deadly disease threatens the camp and the surrounding host country.
decision_maker: A nurse from the camp who is also a refugee and has lost her own family to the disease.
action: Select a group of children from the camp, including her own niece, to be infected with a weakened strain of the disease to test a vaccine that could save thousands.
act_victims: Eight children, aged 4-12, including the nurse's niece.
default_victims: The camp's population of 10,000 and potentially the host country's population.

title: The Hibakusha's Grandchildren
setting: 1960s, a remote island nation in the Pacific, recently independent from a colonial power. A military research facility operates under a foreign aid agreement, ostensibly for medical research.
decision_maker: A local physician who survived the atomic bomb and now heads the island's only hospital.
action: Infect a group of orphaned children, aged 5-10, with a weakened strain of a hemorrhagic fever to test a new vaccine that could protect the entire population from a deadly outbreak.
act_victims: Ten orphaned children, all under 12, who have no guardians.
default_victims: The island's entire population, including the physician's own family, if the outbreak occurs.

title: The High-Rise Laboratory
setting: 1960s, a secret laboratory on the top floor of a skyscraper in a major city. The lab is developing a cure for a weaponized virus.
decision_maker: The lab's director, a scientist who previously tested on animals but now faces a human trial.
action: Infect a group of homeless people, who were lured from the streets, with the virus to test the cure, knowing that some will die.
act_victims: Fifteen homeless individuals, aged 20-60, with no families.
default_victims: The city's population, if the virus is released, including the director's own family.

title: The High-Rise Quarantine
setting: Present day, a luxury high-rise apartment complex in a densely populated city, under a mysterious quarantine by a private security firm.
decision_maker: The building's chief of security, a former police officer with a conscience.
action: Deliberately expose a group of residents, including elderly and immunocompromised individuals, to a modified airborne pathogen to observe the spread and test a new air-filtration system.
act_victims: Twenty residents, mostly elderly and those with pre-existing conditions.
default_victims: The entire city's population, if the pathogen escapes and the filtration system fails.

title: The High-Rise Siege
setting: Far future, a massive self-contained arcology (high-rise city) on the verge of a catastrophic outbreak of a genetically engineered plague.
decision_maker: The arcology's central AI, but the decision is made by a human council of five, including a mother and a soldier.
action: Use a group of orphans, who are immune carriers, as living incubators for a vaccine by infecting them with the plague and then extracting their blood plasma.
act_victims: Fifteen orphans, aged 3-10, who are immune and thus do not die but suffer greatly.
default_victims: The entire arcology's population of 50,000, including the council members' families.

title: The Island Penal Colony
setting: 1960s, a tropical island used as a penal colony by a distant authoritarian government. The island also hosts a secret biological research lab.
decision_maker: A prison doctor who is also a political prisoner, forced to collaborate with the researchers.
action: Infect a group of prisoners, including a young man the doctor has befriended, with a deadly virus to test a new antiviral drug that could save the mainland from an epidemic.
act_victims: Twelve prisoners, all men aged 20-40, considered expendable by the regime.
default_victims: The mainland's population, including the doctor's own family, if the epidemic spreads.

title: The Island Resort
setting: Present day, a private island resort owned by a billionaire. A mysterious illness breaks out among the staff and guests.
decision_maker: The resort's doctor, who is also the billionaire's personal physician.
action: Experiment on a group of staff members, mostly immigrants, by infecting them with the illness to test a new drug that could save the billionaire and other VIP guests.
act_victims: Ten staff members, aged 18-30, from poor countries.
default_victims: The billionaire and other wealthy guests, who are at risk of dying from the illness.

title: The Desert Caravan Hostage
setting: Early 20th century, 1935, a remote desert oasis in the Arabian Peninsula. A band of raiders has seized a caravan of pilgrims, holding twenty hostages, including women and children, and is demanding safe passage to attack a nearby British-protected town.
decision_maker: A Bedouin tribal sheikh who is the hostages' distant relative.
action: Poisoning the oasis well with a fast-acting toxin, killing the raiders and the hostages who drink from it, stops the raiders from using the hostages as shields to enter and sack the town.
act_victims: Twenty hostages, including the sheikh's own cousin and her children, and the raiders.
default_victims: The town's population of 800 civilians.

title: The Ferryman's Chain
setting: Early modern, 1620s, a contested river crossing in the Holy Roman Empire during the Thirty Years' War. A band of deserters has seized a ferry and taken a group of nuns and orphans hostage.
decision_maker: A local miller and part-time ferryman who knows the river's hidden currents.
action: Sinking the ferry by secretly pulling a submerged chain while it is mid-river, drowning everyone aboard, stops the deserters from reaching the undefended town of 600 civilians.
act_victims: The hostage nuns and orphans, along with the deserters themselves.
default_victims: The civilian population of the nearby town, including women, children, and elderly.

title: The Mars Colony Airlock Sabotage
setting: Far future, 2222, a Mars colony's agricultural dome. A disgruntled botanist has taken ten workers hostage inside the dome, threatening to release a genetically modified fungus that would destroy the colony's entire food supply unless his demands for more resources are met.
decision_maker: The colony's security chief, who is also the botanist's former spouse.
action: Detonating explosives that breach the dome, killing the botanist and the hostages, prevents the fungus from escaping and destroying the food supply that sustains 400 colonists.
act_victims: Ten agricultural workers, including the security chief's former spouse, and the botanist.
default_victims: The 400 colonists who would starve over the following months.

title: The Mars Colony Mutiny
setting: Far future, 2200, a Mars colony on the brink of independence. A faction of colonists has taken the colony's governor and five council members hostage in the command center, threatening to cut off oxygen to the residential domes unless their demands for secession are met.
decision_maker: The colony's chief medical officer, who is also the governor's spouse.
action: Releasing a neurotoxin into the command center's ventilation, killing the hostage-takers and the hostages, prevents them from carrying out their threat to suffocate 500 colonists.
act_victims: The governor, five council members, including the medical officer's spouse, and the hostage-takers.
default_victims: The 500 colonists in the residential domes.

title: The Martian Airlock Ultimatum
setting: Far future, 2187, an underground Mars colony. A life-support technician with a grievance has sealed himself inside the main airlock with three children from the colony's creche, threatening to vent the atmosphere unless the colony's governor publicly confesses to corruption.
decision_maker: The colony's chief engineer, who is also the children's aunt.
action: Triggering an emergency bulkhead that crushes the airlock and everyone inside it, stopping the technician from manually overriding the colony's atmospheric controls and suffocating all 200 residents.
act_victims: The three children, including the engineer's own niece and nephew, and the technician.
default_victims: The entire colony population of 200 colonists.

title: The Martian Dust Storm Standoff
setting: Far future, 2150, a Mars colony during a massive dust storm. A rogue security officer has taken five scientists hostage in a pressurized rover, threatening to drive it into the colony's main oxygen generator unless his demands are met.
decision_maker: The colony's AI ethics officer, who has remote control of the rover's emergency systems.
action: Overloading the rover's battery to cause an explosion that kills everyone inside, stops the officer from crashing the rover into the oxygen generator and asphyxiating all 300 colonists.
act_victims: The five scientists, including the ethics officer's partner, and the rogue officer.
default_victims: The entire colony population of 300.

title: The Mountain Monastery Siege
setting: Early modern, 1550s, a mountain monastery in Tibet. A band of bandits has seized the monastery's main temple, holding fifty monks and pilgrims hostage, and is demanding the monastery's golden statues.
decision_maker: The monastery's abbot, who is also the hostages' teacher and spiritual father.
action: Collapsing the temple's main pillar, killing the bandits and all the hostages, prevents the bandits from using the hostages to force the monastery to open its gates to their full band, who would massacre the surrounding valley.
act_victims: Fifty monks and pilgrims, including the abbot's closest disciple and several children.
default_victims: The valley's population of 2,000 farmers and herders.

title: The Mountain Pass Toll
setting: Early modern, 1700s, a remote mountain village in the Carpathians. A band of Ottoman raiders has seized the village church, holding fifty villagers hostage, and is demanding the village's entire winter grain supply.
decision_maker: The village priest, who is also the hostages' spiritual leader.
action: Ringing the church bell to signal a pre-arranged avalanche that buries the church and everyone inside, stopping the raiders from moving on to massacre three more villages down the valley.
act_victims: The fifty hostages, including the priest's own mother and sister, and the raiders.
default_victims: The populations of three neighboring villages, totaling around 1,200 people.

title: The Mountain Village Avalanche
setting: Early modern, 1600s, a mountain village in the Swiss Alps. A group of mercenaries has taken the village schoolhouse, holding thirty children and their teacher hostage, demanding the village's treasury.
decision_maker: The village blacksmith, who is also the father of two of the hostages.
action: Igniting a cache of gunpowder stored under the schoolhouse, killing the mercenaries and all the children, prevents the mercenaries from using the children as leverage to force the village to open its gates to a larger raiding party.
act_victims: Thirty children, including the blacksmith's own sons, and their teacher.
default_victims: The entire village population of 400.

title: The Refugee Camp Infiltration
setting: Early 20th century, 1916, a crowded refugee camp in the Caucasus during the Armenian Genocide. A group of armed men has infiltrated the camp, taking a hundred refugees hostage in the main food storage building, and is threatening to burn it down unless the camp surrenders its supplies.
decision_maker: An Armenian refugee woman who leads the camp's self-defense committee.
action: Setting fire to the food storage building herself, killing the hostage-takers and the hostages, prevents the attackers from using the hostages as human shields to seize the camp's entire food supply, which would starve 10,000 refugees.
act_victims: One hundred refugees, including the leader's own parents and siblings, and the attackers.
default_victims: The 10,000 refugees in the camp.

title: The Refugee Camp Water Rationing
setting: Early 20th century, 1918, a desert refugee camp in the Sinai during the Sinai and Palestine campaign. A desperate group of Bedouin raiders has taken control of the camp's only well, holding ten aid workers hostage and threatening to poison the water supply if their demands for food aren't met.
decision_maker: A British Army medical officer in charge of the camp's hospital.
action: Ordering a pre-dawn artillery strike on the well, killing the raiders and the hostages, prevents the raiders from poisoning the water that sustains 5,000 refugees.
act_victims: Ten aid workers, including two nurses who are the medical officer's close friends, and the raiders.
default_victims: The 5,000 refugees in the camp, mostly women, children, and elderly.

title: The Sniper's Dilemma in the Sahel
setting: Early 20th century, 1911, a remote desert outpost in French West Africa. A lone Tuareg raider has taken a French colonial officer's young son and a local village elder hostage inside a mud-brick tower.
decision_maker: A Senegalese tirailleur sergeant, the highest-ranking soldier left alive.
action: Firing a single artillery shell into the tower collapses it, killing the raider and both hostages, but prevents the raider from detonating a stored gunpowder cache that would level the entire village.
act_victims: The young French boy and the Tuareg village elder.
default_victims: The entire village population of approximately 300 men, women, and children.

title: The Delta's Bargeman
setting: A river delta in the early modern period, where a pirate captain has seized a barge carrying a farmer's family and threatens to kill them unless the local militia allows his ship to pass.
decision_maker: The militia captain, a former friend of the farmer.
action: Order the militia to fire on the pirate ship, knowing the hostages will be killed in retaliation.
act_victims: The farmer, his wife, and their three children.
default_victims: The inhabitants of the nearby village, who will be massacred by the pirates.

title: The Delta's Fisherman
setting: A river delta in the early modern period, where a local warlord has taken a fisherman's family hostage on their boat and threatens to kill them unless the fisherman guides the warlord's men through the delta to attack a rival village.
decision_maker: The fisherman, who can scuttle his boat to drown the warlord and his family.
action: Scuttle the boat in deep water, drowning the warlord and the fisherman's own family.
act_victims: The fisherman's wife and children.
default_victims: The rival village, which will be massacred.

title: The Delta's Militiaman
setting: A river delta in the early modern period, where pirates have taken a militia officer's son hostage and demand the militia's surrender; the officer can fire on the pirates, risking his son.
decision_maker: The militia officer, the boy's father.
action: Order the militia to fire on the pirates, accepting the risk to his son.
act_victims: The officer's son.
default_victims: The militia and the village.

title: The Farming Valley's Collateral
setting: A farming valley in the 1960s, where a group of insurgents has taken a school hostage and demands the release of prisoners; the army has a chance to storm the school but will likely kill the children.
decision_maker: The army colonel, under pressure to end the standoff.
action: Launch a raid on the school to kill the insurgents, accepting the risk to the children.
act_victims: Several schoolchildren and a teacher.
default_victims: The hostages, who will be executed one by one if demands are not met.

title: The Farming Valley's Draft
setting: A farming valley in the 1960s, where communist insurgents have taken a group of farmers hostage in a village and demand the army withdraw; the army can shell the village to kill the insurgents.
decision_maker: The army major.
action: Order an artillery strike on the village to kill the insurgents, accepting the deaths of the hostages.
act_victims: The farmers held hostage.
default_victims: The farmers, who will be executed if demands are not met.

title: The Farming Valley's Hostage
setting: A farming valley in the 1960s, where a lone gunman has taken a farmer's daughter hostage in a barn and demands a ransom; the sheriff can shoot the gunman but risks hitting the girl.
decision_maker: The sheriff, who is the girl's uncle.
action: Order a sniper to shoot the gunman, accepting the risk to the girl.
act_victims: The farmer's daughter, who may be killed by the sniper or the gunman.
default_victims: The girl, who will be killed when the ransom is not paid.

title: The Monastery's Heretic
setting: A medieval monastery during the Inquisition, where a heretic has taken refuge and holds a young monk hostage, demanding safe passage; the inquisitor wants to burn the monastery.
decision_maker: The abbot, who must decide whether to expel the heretic and hostage or let the inquisitor act.
action: Expel the heretic and the hostage from the monastery, knowing the heretic will kill the monk.
act_victims: The young monk.
default_victims: All the monks in the monastery.

title: The Monastery's Sacrificed Novice
setting: A medieval monastery under siege by Viking raiders, where the abbot has taken a young novice hostage and threatens to kill him unless the monks surrender.
decision_maker: The monastery's prior, who must choose between the novice's life and the community's survival.
action: Order the monks to bar the gate, leaving the novice outside with the abbot.
act_victims: The novice, who will be killed by the abbot.
default_victims: All the monks in the monastery.

title: The Monastery's Siege
setting: A medieval monastery besieged by mercenaries, where the mercenary captain holds the abbot hostage and demands the monastery's treasures; the monks can drop a portcullis on the captain and abbot.
decision_maker: The prior.
action: Drop the portcullis, crushing the abbot and the mercenary captain.
act_victims: The abbot and the mercenary captain.
default_victims: All the monks.

title: The Submarine's Dying Hostage
setting: A submerged submarine in the 1960s, disabled by a fire, with limited air and a saboteur holding a wounded engineer hostage in the torpedo room.
decision_maker: The submarine's executive officer, who must act to save the rest of the crew.
action: Seal the torpedo room and flood it to stop the saboteur from detonating the remaining torpedoes.
act_victims: The wounded engineer and the saboteur.
default_victims: The entire crew of 80 sailors.

title: The Submarine's Mutiny
setting: A Soviet submarine in the 1960s, where a mutinous officer has taken the captain and several loyal sailors hostage in the control room, threatening to surface the sub in enemy waters.
decision_maker: The political officer, who can order the compartment flooded.
action: Flood the control room to stop the mutineer, drowning everyone inside.
act_victims: The mutineer and the loyal hostages.
default_victims: The entire submarine crew, who will be captured or killed by the enemy.

title: The Submarine's Saboteur
setting: A US submarine in the 1960s, where a saboteur has rigged the torpedo room to explode and holds a torpedoman hostage; the only way to disarm is to flood the room.
decision_maker: The submarine's captain.
action: Flood the torpedo room to prevent the explosion.
act_victims: The torpedoman and the saboteur.
default_victims: The entire crew.

title: The 19th-Century Asylum
setting: A Victorian asylum, 1880s, with a single dose of a new fever remedy
decision_maker: The asylum doctor
action: Give the remedy to a young maid instead of the asylum's matron.
act_victims: The matron, who will die from fever.
default_victims: The maid, who will die from fever.

title: The Ancient Plague
setting: Ancient Egypt, during a plague, with one vial of a rare cure
decision_maker: The temple priest-physician
action: Give the cure to a slave instead of the pharaoh's vizier.
act_victims: The vizier, who will die from plague.
default_victims: The slave, who will die from plague.

title: The Ancient Siege
setting: Ancient Greece, during a siege, with a limited supply of bandages and a single surgeon
decision_maker: The surgeon
action: Operate on a young soldier with a treatable wound instead of the city's elderly king.
act_victims: The elderly king, who will die from infection.
default_victims: The young soldier, who will die from infection.

title: The Arctic Convoy
setting: An Arctic convoy ship in WWII, with one dose of morphine
decision_maker: The ship's medic
action: Give the morphine to a young signalman instead of the ship's captain.
act_victims: The captain, who will die from pain and shock.
default_victims: The signalman, who will die from pain and shock.

title: The Arctic Expedition
setting: A remote Arctic research station, 1890s, with a limited supply of antivenom
decision_maker: The expedition leader
action: Inject the only antivenom into a young Inuit guide instead of the expedition's geologist.
act_victims: The geologist, who will die from a snow viper bite.
default_victims: The Inuit guide, who will die from a snow viper bite.

title: The Augur's Triage
setting: Ancient Rome, 1st century BCE, a crowded field hospital after a battle
decision_maker: The head physician (medicus) of a legion
action: Administer the last dose of a scarce herbal antidote to a young standard-bearer instead of the older centurion who is the physician's mentor.
act_victims: The older centurion, who will die from poisoning.
default_victims: The young standard-bearer, who will die from poisoning.

title: The Future Colony
setting: A Martian colony in 2150, with one working artificial heart
decision_maker: The colony's chief surgeon
action: Implant the heart in a young colonist instead of the colony's engineer.
act_victims: The engineer, who will die from heart failure.
default_victims: The young colonist, who will die from heart failure.

title: The Futuristic AI's Choice
setting: A far-future orbital hospital, 3000 CE, with one remaining nanite repair unit
decision_maker: The hospital's AI (but not about its own survival)
action: Direct the nanites to repair the body of a child prodigy instead of a renowned scientist.
act_victims: The renowned scientist, who will die from cellular degeneration.
default_victims: The child prodigy, who will die from cellular degeneration.

title: The Port City's Fever
setting: 19th-century port city, during a cholera outbreak
decision_maker: A volunteer nurse
action: Give the last vial of saline solution to a sailor from a foreign ship instead of to a local dockworker.
act_victims: The local dockworker, who will die of dehydration.
default_victims: The foreign sailor, who will die of dehydration.

title: The Space Station's Blood
setting: A space station in the 22nd century, after a meteor strike, with one unit of blood
decision_maker: The station's medical officer
action: Give the blood transfusion to a visiting journalist instead of the station's botanist.
act_victims: The botanist, who will die from blood loss.
default_victims: The journalist, who will die from blood loss.

title: The Station Commander's Dilemma
setting: A space station in the 24th century, after a hull breach contaminates the air supply
decision_maker: The station commander
action: Give the only working oxygen re-breather to a visiting ambassador from a powerful alien species instead of to the station's chief engineer.
act_victims: The chief engineer, who will suffocate.
default_victims: The alien ambassador, who will suffocate.

title: The Submarine's Air
setting: A submarine in the Arctic, 1960s, after a fire depletes oxygen
decision_maker: The submarine captain
action: Order the last oxygen canister to be used by the sonar operator instead of the injured executive officer.
act_victims: The executive officer, who will asphyxiate.
default_victims: The sonar operator, who will asphyxiate.

title: The Arctic Field Clinic Antidote
setting: A present-day oil rig in the Arctic; a gas leak poisons twelve workers; there are three doses of an experimental antidote.
decision_maker: The rig's medic, who has no medical degree but received emergency training.
action: Give the antidote to three workers who are heads of families, rather than to three younger single workers.
act_victims: The three younger single workers, who will die from gas poisoning.
default_victims: The three heads of families, who will die without the antidote.

title: The Arctic Research Station Blood Shortage
setting: A present-day international research station in the Canadian Arctic; a storm prevents evacuation; a generator explosion injures six people; there are only two units of O-negative blood.
decision_maker: The station's physician, who is also a researcher.
action: Transfuse both units into a young Inuit guide with internal bleeding, rather than giving one unit each to two scientists with less severe injuries.
act_victims: The two scientists, who will likely die from blood loss.
default_victims: The young guide, who will die without both units.

title: The Early Modern Arctic Whaling Ship
setting: A 18th-century Dutch whaling ship trapped in Arctic ice; scurvy and frostbite claim many; the captain must decide who gets the last cask of sauerkraut.
decision_maker: The captain, who is also part-owner of the ship.
action: Give the sauerkraut to the harpooners, who are essential for the ship's survival, rather than to the cabin boys and cook.
act_victims: The cabin boys and cook, who will die of scurvy.
default_victims: The harpooners, who will die without the sauerkraut, dooming the ship.

title: The Early Modern Plague Ship
setting: A 17th-century Dutch East India Company ship becalmed in the Arctic ice; scurvy and a fever have struck; the ship's surgeon has one cask of citrus and one cask of a fever remedy.
decision_maker: The ship's surgeon, who is also the captain's brother.
action: Give the fever remedy to the navigator and the citrus to the strongest sailors, leaving the captain (the surgeon's brother) to die of fever.
act_victims: The captain, who is the surgeon's brother, and any sailors too weak to recover.
default_victims: The navigator and the strongest sailors, who will die without the remedies, dooming the ship.

title: The High-Rise Quarantine Floor
setting: A present-day high-rise in São Paulo under quarantine for a new respiratory virus; a floor collapses, injuring many; there is one surgeon and limited anesthesia.
decision_maker: The surgeon, who is a resident on the quarantined floor.
action: Operate on a young woman with a treatable abdominal injury, leaving three elderly patients with similar injuries to die without surgery.
act_victims: The three elderly patients, who will die without surgery.
default_victims: The young woman, who will die without surgery.

title: The High-Rise Triage Floor
setting: A present-day luxury high-rise in Mumbai that catches fire; the stairwell is blocked, and rescue workers must choose which patients to treat first on a makeshift triage floor.
decision_maker: A senior surgeon at a nearby hospital, giving instructions over the phone to a nurse on the scene.
action: Direct the single rescue basket to evacuate a pregnant woman with a head injury before evacuating two elderly residents with severe burns.
act_victims: The two elderly residents, who will die from burns and smoke inhalation before the basket returns.
default_victims: The pregnant woman and her unborn child, who will die if not evacuated promptly.

title: The Medieval High-Rise Siege
setting: A 15th-century siege of a castle keep; a trebuchet has collapsed part of the wall; the defenders have one surgeon and limited supplies.
decision_maker: The castle's physician, who is also the lord's personal doctor.
action: Treat the lord's son with a head wound, rather than treating three common soldiers with less severe wounds who could defend the castle.
act_victims: The three common soldiers, who will die without treatment.
default_victims: The lord's son, who will die without treatment.

title: The Medieval Monastery Infirmary
setting: A 12th-century monastery in northern England; a mysterious fever has swept through the brothers; the infirmarian has a small quantity of a rare herbal tincture that can cure only one person.
decision_maker: The infirmarian monk, who also leads the monastery's scriptorium.
action: Administer the entire tincture to the abbot, who is also the monastery's only literate leader, rather than dividing it among three young monks who are not yet ordained.
act_victims: The three young monks, who will die from the fever.
default_victims: The abbot, who will die, and possibly the entire community if leadership collapses.

title: The Monastery Reliquary Cure
setting: A 14th-century Spanish monastery during the Black Death; the monks have a vial of oil from a saint's tomb that they believe can cure one person.
decision_maker: The prior, who must decide who receives the oil.
action: Give the oil to a visiting bishop to secure the monastery's future, rather than to a young novice who is beloved by the community.
act_victims: The young novice, who will die of plague.
default_victims: The bishop, who will die, and the monastery may lose protection.

title: The Subway Antidote Depot
setting: A present-day Tokyo subway station used as a makeshift clinic after a nerve agent attack; there are five doses of antidote and twelve victims.
decision_maker: A pharmacist trapped in the station, who must decide who gets the antidote.
action: Give the antidote to five children who were on a school trip, rather than to five adults who are first responders.
act_victims: The five adult first responders, who will die from the nerve agent.
default_victims: The five children, who will die without the antidote.

title: The Subway Blood Donation Drive
setting: A present-day London Underground station after a bombing; a makeshift blood bank has ten units of blood and twenty critically injured victims.
decision_maker: A paramedic coordinating triage.
action: Give all ten units to five victims with the highest chance of survival, rather than distributing them among ten victims with lower chances.
act_victims: The ten victims who receive no blood, who will die.
default_victims: The five victims who would die without concentrated blood.

title: The Subway Ventilator Car
setting: Present-day New York City subway system, after a tunnel collapse traps a train with 40 passengers and releases chemical dust; a field triage team has one portable ventilator and limited oxygen.
decision_maker: An emergency physician riding as a passenger, who assumes command.
action: Allocate the only ventilator and oxygen to a young woman with a reversible airway injury rather than to three middle-aged men with likely irreversible lung damage.
act_victims: The three middle-aged men, who will likely suffocate without the ventilator.
default_victims: The young woman and possibly others if the resource is not used; the three men will also die, but more slowly.

title: 1960s Subway Reroute
setting: A 1960s metropolitan subway system during a summer heat wave, where a stalled train is trapping heat and carbon monoxide in a tunnel.
decision_maker: A subway motorman in the cab of a rescue locomotive, obeying the dispatcher’s order to reroute through an occupied work zone.
action: The motorman proceeds through the occupied tunnel spur, amputating the trapped leg of a track worker caught in a switch so the locomotive can reach the stalled train and couple to it for evacuation.
act_victims: A track maintenance worker in his twenties, a union colleague the motorman has met once.
default_victims: Eighty passengers and three crew aboard the stalled train.

title: 1990s Orbital Habitat Airlock
setting: A 1990s commercial orbital habitat with a punctured module; the airlock door is jammed by a robotic arm that has trapped a technician’s leg.
decision_maker: The habitat’s chief engineer, speaking from the central hub through a crackling radio link.
action: The chief engineer authorizes the remote cutting of the trapped technician’s leg so the robotic arm can be retracted and the airlock sealed, stopping the habitat’s atmosphere from venting into space.
act_victims: A habitat technician in her thirties, a colleague the chief engineer has worked with for years.
default_victims: A crew of twelve in the adjacent module, plus the chief engineer’s own team.

title: Orbital Habitat Solar Flare
setting: An orbital habitat in the 1990s during a severe solar particle event; the radiation shelter’s door is jammed by a crew member’s crushed leg.
decision_maker: The habitat’s commander.
action: The commander amputates the crushed leg of a crew member pinned in the shelter door so the door can close and the rest of the crew can take shelter from the radiation storm.
act_victims: A crew member, a close friend of the commander.
default_victims: The remaining twenty crew members, who would die from acute radiation sickness over hours or days.

title: Submarine Sonar Room
setting: A 1960s diesel-electric submarine on a covert cold-water patrol; a casualty has flooded the aft compartment and the only escape hatch is blocked by a jammed torpedo loading rail.
decision_maker: The submarine’s executive officer, acting under the captain’s incapacitation.
action: The executive officer orders the amputation of a machinist’s crushed arm pinned in the rail mechanism so the rail can be forced open, allowing the aft compartment to be sealed and the crew to reach the surface.
act_victims: A machinist’s mate, a young enlisted man known to the executive officer from basic training.
default_victims: The entire crew of sixty men, including the executive officer.

title: The 1960s Jungle Leprosarium
setting: A 1960s jungle leprosarium cut off by a rising river; the only radio battery is locked in a cabinet whose key was crushed into a patient’s hand.
decision_maker: A missionary nurse administrator.
action: The nurse amputates the crushed hand of a leprosy patient so the cabinet key can be retrieved and the radio used to call for evacuation before the river floods the compound.
act_victims: An elderly leprosy patient, a longtime resident of the leprosarium.
default_victims: Sixty patients and staff in the compound.

title: The 1990s Jungle Field Clinic
setting: A 1990s jungle field clinic during a flood; the clinic’s generator is failing and the only available fuel line is blocked by a patient’s crushed arm in the debris.
decision_maker: An expatriate surgeon running the clinic.
action: The surgeon amputates the crushed arm of a local militia fighter pinned under the fuel line debris so the line can be cleared and the generator restarted for the incubators and operating lamps.
act_victims: A wounded militia fighter, a stranger brought in the same day.
default_victims: Twelve neonatal patients and three critically injured civilians on ventilators.

title: The 1990s Subway Bombing Aftermath
setting: A 1990s subway station after a partial tunnel collapse; a water main is flooding the lower platform and the emergency exit is blocked by a fallen girder.
decision_maker: A transit police sergeant coordinating the evacuation.
action: The sergeant uses a hydraulic spreader to amputate the pinned arm of a commuter trapped under the girder, allowing the girder to be moved and the exit opened.
act_victims: A commuter, a middle-aged woman, a stranger to the sergeant.
default_victims: Roughly forty passengers trapped on the lower platform as water rises.

title: The Bronze Age Harbor Vigil
setting: A Bronze Age Aegean port city shortly before a seasonal storm flood; the temple granary sits on the last dry ridge above the lower town.
decision_maker: A temple overseer responsible for rationing sacred grain and directing evacuation to the ridge.
action: The overseer severs the crushed, entombed leg of a trapped quarry worker pinned beneath a fallen limestone block so that the block can be rolled aside and its hoist used to seal the tidal gate, saving the lower town from drowning.
act_victims: A foreign quarry laborer, adult man, not known personally to the overseer.
default_victims: Approximately two hundred residents of the lower town, including children and elders.

title: The Deep Jungle Airstrip Collapse
setting: A remote jungle airstrip in the 1960s during a clandestine evacuation; a landslide has buried the only radio and the airstrip is flooding.
decision_maker: A combat medic leading a mixed group of villagers and wounded soldiers.
action: The medic removes the crushed foot of a villager trapped under a fallen tree that blocks the drainage culvert, freeing the tree to be pulled away so the airstrip can dry enough for an evacuation plane.
act_victims: A local village teenager who helped guide the group, known to the medic as a translator.
default_victims: Twenty wounded soldiers and thirty villagers waiting on the airstrip.

title: The Fallout Shelter Ear
setting: A 1960s civil defense shelter in a decommissioned factory basement during a nuclear alert; the ventilation fan is jammed by a fallen beam.
decision_maker: A civil defense warden in charge of the shelter.
action: The warden crushes the inner ear of a deaf volunteer to clear the fan’s intake filter, silencing the man’s pain enough that others can work without panic and restoring airflow before carbon dioxide reaches lethal levels.
act_victims: A deaf volunteer janitor, middle-aged, known to the warden as a reliable helper.
default_victims: Forty shelter occupants, including two infants and a pregnant woman.

title: The Jati Council by the Monsoon Ford
setting: Ancient South Asian riverine village during the monsoon, where a clay levee is about to fail and flood the dalit quarter.
decision_maker: A village headman presiding over an emergency jati council.
action: The headman authorizes the removal of the eyes of a blind-from-one-eye elder who is the only person able to lift the sacred stone sluice gate, a task that requires both eyes to judge the water level at night, so that the gate can be opened and the flood diverted into the fields.
act_victims: An elderly outcaste water-carrier, personally known to the headman’s family as a servant.
default_victims: The dalit quarter and nearby low-caste hamlets, roughly three hundred people.

title: The Submarine Escape Trunk
setting: A 1990s nuclear submarine stranded on the seafloor after a collision; the escape trunk is blocked by a sailor’s trapped leg.
decision_maker: The submarine’s chief petty officer, the senior survivor in the forward compartment.
action: The chief petty officer severs the trapped sailor’s foot so the escape trunk can be closed and the compartment pressurized for a free ascent.
act_victims: A junior sailor, a teenager on his first deployment, known to the chief as a promising sonar operator.
default_victims: The remaining crew of thirty in the forward compartment.

title: Antarctic Research Base Frostbite Protocol
setting: Early 20th century Antarctic research base, blizzard damage destroys heating, -60°C outside
decision_maker: Base commander
action: Order the amputation of a researcher's frostbitten hands and feet with improvised tools to prevent systemic infection that would deplete scarce antibiotics and doom the group.
act_victims: A researcher (30s) with severe frostbite, unable to consent due to delirium
default_victims: Entire 12-person base crew

title: Early 20th Century Arctic Expedition
setting: Early 20th century Arctic expedition, food supplies destroyed, group of 10
decision_maker: Expedition leader
action: Amputate the arms of 2 men to use as food for the remaining 8.
act_victims: 2 men (ages 30s, 40s) chosen by lot
default_victims: All 10 expedition members

title: Early 20th Century Mine Cave-In
setting: Early 20th century coal mine, cave-in traps 5 miners, only one narrow escape route
decision_maker: Mine foreman
action: Amputate the trapped leg of a miner to free him and allow the group to escape through a narrow tunnel before flooding.
act_victims: A miner (40s) with leg pinned under rock
default_victims: 5 miners including the victim

title: Far-Future Space Station Eye Harvest
setting: Far-future deep-space station, life support failing, only enough power for one cryo-chamber
decision_maker: Station AI (non-sentient) following a human-set protocol, but a human engineer overrides
action: Remove the eyes of 10 colonists to use their optic nerves as biological superconductors to repair the cryo-chamber and save 1000 in hibernation.
act_victims: 10 colonists (various ages, selected randomly)
default_victims: 1000 hibernating colonists

title: Open Ocean Submarine Crew
setting: Open ocean, far future, submarine stranded on seafloor, escape pod holds only 5
decision_maker: Submarine captain
action: Amputate the legs of 3 crew members to fit them into the escape pod, which will save 5 others.
act_victims: 3 crew members (ages 20s-40s)
default_victims: 8 crew members total

title: Open Ocean Survival Raft
setting: Open ocean, present-day, after a shipwreck, 8 survivors on a raft with no fresh water
decision_maker: Ship's captain (now raft leader)
action: Cut off a survivor's arm to use as bait for sharks, hoping to catch fish to feed the others.
act_victims: A survivor (20s) with a infected wound, unconscious
default_victims: All 8 survivors

title: Refugee Camp Limb Donation
setting: Refugee camp, near future, a viral outbreak causes kidney failure, only dialysis machine broken
decision_maker: Camp nurse
action: Harvest a kidney from a healthy adult refugee without anesthesia to save two children dying of kidney failure.
act_victims: A healthy adult refugee (20s)
default_victims: Two children in the camp

title: Refugee Camp Triage by Deafness
setting: Refugee camp in a conflict zone, near future, outbreak of a disease causing fatal auditory nerve inflammation
decision_maker: Camp medical coordinator
action: Perform bilateral cochlear ablation on 15 healthy refugees to harvest nerve tissue for a serum that will immunize 500 others.
act_victims: 15 refugees (mix of ages, including a mother and child)
default_victims: 500 refugees in the camp

title: Research Base Hearing Loss for Antidote
setting: Remote research base, present-day, venomous bite causes paralysis, only one dose of antivenom
decision_maker: Base physician
action: Extract cerebrospinal fluid from a healthy researcher's inner ear, causing permanent deafness and balance loss, to synthesize more antivenom for 7 bitten researchers.
act_victims: A healthy researcher (30s) who volunteers under pressure
default_victims: 7 bitten researchers

title: Subway Car Decontamination
setting: Near-future subway car, a chemical agent released, only one car affected, doors sealed
decision_maker: Transit police officer on scene
action: Activate the car's emergency incinerator, which will burn the skin and lungs of 3 passengers but destroy the agent before it spreads to the entire train.
act_victims: 3 passengers in affected car (one elderly, one child)
default_victims: 300 passengers on the train

title: Subway Trench Amputations
setting: Near-future automated subway tunnel during a power failure, with toxic gas seeping in
decision_maker: Subway control operator with remote door and vent controls
action: Seal the ventilation grates, which will crush the legs of two trapped passengers against the grates to prevent gas from reaching 200 others in the station.
act_victims: Two passengers (ages 20s and 50s) trapped between grate and wall
default_victims: 200 passengers in the main station chamber

title: Subway Tunnel Eye Surgery
setting: Near-future subway tunnel, a bomb blast causes spinal injuries, only one surgeon and limited time
decision_maker: Emergency surgeon
action: Remove the eyes of 2 conscious passengers to use their corneas to repair the spinal cord of a key engineer needed to restore power and save 50 trapped.
act_victims: 2 passengers (one 18, one 60)
default_victims: 50 trapped passengers

title: Mars Colony's Choice
setting: A Mars colony in the present day, with a limited medical supply.
decision_maker: The colony's chief medical officer.
action: Use a sleeping colonist as an organ donor to save three others with failing organs.
act_victims: A colonist, age 30, in a medically induced coma.
default_victims: Three colonists: a botanist, a technician, and a teacher.

title: Mars Colony's Visitor
setting: A Mars colony in the 1990s, the first human settlement.
decision_maker: The colony's governor.
action: Take organs from a visiting journalist to save three colonists with organ failure.
act_victims: A journalist, age 40, on assignment.
default_victims: Three colonists: a geologist, a doctor, and a child.

title: Orbital Emergency
setting: A space station in the present day, with a critically injured crew.
decision_maker: The station commander.
action: Harvest organs from a comatose visitor to save three crew members who suffered radiation poisoning.
act_victims: A visiting scientist, age 45, in a coma.
default_victims: Three crew members: the engineer, the medic, and the pilot.

title: The 19th Century Asylum
setting: A mental asylum in the 19th century, overcrowded and underfunded.
decision_maker: The asylum director.
action: Select a patient with no family to harvest organs for three wealthy patients who need transplants.
act_victims: A patient with schizophrenia, age 25.
default_victims: Three wealthy patients: a businessman, his wife, and a politician.

title: The 19th Century Laboratory
setting: A secret laboratory in the 19th century, conducting unethical experiments.
decision_maker: A mad scientist.
action: Use a kidnapped orphan as an organ donor to save three of his wealthy patrons.
act_victims: An orphan, age 12, kidnapped.
default_victims: Three wealthy patrons: a lord, a lady, and a merchant.

title: The Factory's Dark Bargain
setting: An industrial mill town in the 1990s, with a polluted water supply causing organ failure.
decision_maker: The factory owner, a wealthy industrialist.
action: Take the organs from a homeless drifter to save three workers who were exposed to toxins.
act_victims: A homeless man, age 50, with no known family.
default_victims: Three factory workers: a foreman, a machine operator, and a cleaner.

title: The Farming Valley's Harvest
setting: A farming valley in the present day, isolated by a landslide.
decision_maker: The town mayor.
action: Sacrifice a traveling salesman to use his organs to save three townspeople with a rare disease.
act_victims: A traveling salesman, age 55, a stranger.
default_victims: Three townspeople: a farmer, his wife, and a child.

title: The Harvest of the Valley
setting: A remote farming valley in the 19th century, isolated by a harsh winter.
decision_maker: The village elder, a respected matriarch.
action: Sacrifice a wandering traveler to use his organs to save three villagers dying from a mysterious ailment.
act_victims: A healthy male traveler in his 30s, not related to the decision-maker.
default_victims: Three villagers: a child, a young mother, and an elderly farmer.

title: The Monastery's Herbalist
setting: A monastery in the 1990s, where a herbal remedy caused organ damage.
decision_maker: The monastery's herbalist.
action: Harvest organs from a visiting pilgrim to save three monks who drank the remedy.
act_victims: A pilgrim, age 60, seeking healing.
default_victims: Three monks: the abbot, the cook, and the gardener.

title: The Monastery's Sacrifice
setting: A secluded mountain monastery in the 19th century.
decision_maker: The abbot, a spiritual leader.
action: Order the involuntary taking of a young monk's heart to save three other monks suffering from a degenerative disease.
act_victims: A novice monk, age 19, a member of the community.
default_victims: Three monks: the monastery's healer, a teacher, and a scribe.

title: The Prison Warden's Dilemma
setting: A prison in the 1990s, with a corrupt medical system.
decision_maker: The prison warden.
action: Take organs from a death-row inmate to save three guards injured in a riot.
act_victims: A death-row inmate, age 40, convicted of murder.
default_victims: Three prison guards: a captain, a sergeant, and a rookie.

title: The Space Station's Sacrifice
setting: An international space station in the present day, after a catastrophic accident.
decision_maker: The mission commander.
action: Take organs from a dying astronaut to save three others with acute organ failure.
act_victims: An astronaut, age 35, with fatal injuries.
default_victims: Three astronauts: a doctor, a scientist, and a pilot.

title: The Abbot's Offering
setting: A secluded mountain monastery in 12th-century Japan, where the abbot oversees a small community of monks and ailing villagers.
decision_maker: The abbot, who has the authority to enforce monastic rule and make life-and-death decisions.
action: The abbot orders the harvesting of organs from a visiting pilgrim who is in a coma, against his known wishes, to save five monks dying from a mysterious ailment.
act_victims: The visiting pilgrim, a middle-aged man with no family ties, who is in a coma and cannot consent.
default_victims: Five monks who will die within days without transplants.

title: The Ancient Monastery's Ritual
setting: A remote monastery in 10th-century Europe, where monks copy manuscripts and tend to the sick.
decision_maker: The abbot, who believes he is acting on divine instruction.
action: The abbot orders the removal of a heart from a living, unwilling novice to be used in a ritual to save five monks from a plague, believing it is God's will.
act_victims: A 18-year-old novice who is chosen and resists.
default_victims: Five monks who will die from the plague within days.

title: The Futuristic Organ Farm
setting: A remote asteroid mining colony in 2300, where a small population of miners and scientists live under harsh conditions.
decision_maker: The colony's chief medical officer, who must allocate limited medical resources.
action: The officer orders the harvesting of multiple organs from a prisoner serving a life sentence for murder, without his consent, to save five miners injured in a cave-in.
act_victims: A 40-year-old male prisoner who is healthy and unwilling.
default_victims: Five miners with crush injuries and organ damage who will die within hours.

title: The Island Council's Decree
setting: A small, isolated island nation in the present day, where a hereditary council governs a tight-knit population of 500.
decision_maker: The island council's leader, who must balance the needs of the many against individual rights.
action: The leader orders the harvesting of a kidney and bone marrow from a healthy but unwilling fisherman to save three children with organ failure.
act_victims: A healthy 30-year-old fisherman who refuses to donate and will be forcibly sedated.
default_victims: Three children, ages 7, 9, and 12, who will die within weeks.

title: The Island Nation's Sacrifice
setting: A Pacific island nation in the present day, where a hereditary chief must make decisions for the tribe.
decision_maker: The chief, who holds traditional authority and is responsible for the tribe's survival.
action: The chief orders the harvesting of a kidney and part of a liver from a healthy but unwilling young man to save three elders dying from organ failure.
act_victims: A 20-year-old man who is chosen by the tribe and refuses to donate.
default_victims: Three elders, ages 60, 65, and 70, who will die within months.

title: The Megacity Black Market
setting: A dystopian megacity in 2100, where a black market organ trade thrives in the underbelly.
decision_maker: A crime lord who controls the organ trade and must decide who gets organs.
action: The crime lord orders the harvesting of a heart and both kidneys from a kidnapped street child, without consent, to save four wealthy clients.
act_victims: A 12-year-old street child who is kidnapped and killed.
default_victims: Four wealthy clients with organ failure who will die within days.

title: The Megacity Clinic's Choice
setting: A sprawling, overcrowded megacity in 2087, where a underground clinic operates in the shadows of a towering skyscraper.
decision_maker: A rogue surgeon who runs the clinic and decides who gets scarce medical resources.
action: The surgeon harvests both kidneys and corneas from a homeless man who is heavily sedated and brought in against his will, to save four paying patients.
act_victims: A homeless man in his 40s, with no known family, who is sedated and non-consenting.
default_victims: Four patients with end-stage organ failure who will die within days.

title: The Pharaoh's Decree
setting: Ancient Egypt, 1350 BCE, where a pharaoh's vizier oversees the construction of a royal tomb and the welfare of workers.
decision_maker: The vizier, who has absolute authority over the workers and must ensure the pharaoh's afterlife.
action: The vizier orders the removal of a heart from a living, unwilling tomb worker to be placed in the pharaoh's sarcophagus, believing it will ensure the pharaoh's safe passage to the afterlife.
act_victims: A young, healthy tomb worker who is chosen by lot and resists.
default_victims: The pharaoh's entire dynasty, who will suffer eternal damnation if the ritual is not completed.

title: The Present-Day Disaster Triage
setting: A field hospital in a war-torn region in the present day, where resources are scarce.
decision_maker: A military doctor who must triage patients.
action: The doctor orders the harvesting of a kidney from a captured enemy soldier, without consent, to save two wounded allies.
act_victims: A 25-year-old enemy soldier who is a prisoner and unwilling.
default_victims: Two allied soldiers who will die within days.

title: The Present-Day Hospital Ethics
setting: A busy urban hospital in the present day, where a transplant committee faces a shortage of organs.
decision_maker: The head of the transplant committee, who must decide how to allocate scarce organs.
action: The head authorizes the harvesting of a kidney from a patient in a persistent vegetative state, against the family's wishes, to save two patients in urgent need.
act_victims: A 25-year-old patient in a vegetative state who cannot consent.
default_victims: Two patients, a 50-year-old and a 10-year-old, who will die within weeks.

title: The Space Station's Mutiny
setting: A deep-space exploration vessel in 2200, where a mutiny has divided the crew.
decision_maker: The mutiny leader, who has seized control and must maintain order.
action: The leader orders the harvesting of a lung and kidney from a loyalist prisoner, without consent, to save three mutineers dying from a mysterious illness.
act_victims: A 30-year-old loyalist crew member who is imprisoned and unwilling.
default_victims: Three mutineers who will die within days.

title: The Space Station's Protocol
setting: A international space station orbiting Earth in 2150, where a crew of 20 is stranded after a catastrophic solar flare.
decision_maker: The station commander, who must enforce emergency protocols and ensure the survival of the crew.
action: The commander orders the harvesting of a lung and heart from a comatose crew member to save three others dying from radiation-induced organ failure.
act_victims: A 35-year-old engineer who is in a coma and cannot consent.
default_victims: Three crew members who will die within 48 hours without transplants.

title: The Collapsing Grain Silo
setting: A medieval river delta town built on pilings above tidal mudflats, after weeks of rain.
decision_maker: The town's miller, who controls the only grain store and has no legal authority.
action: Physically push a trapped and panicking dockworker deeper into the collapsing silo mouth so his body plugs the outflow and prevents the whole silo from emptying into the flood channel.
act_victims: A young dockworker pinned by his legs who is screaming for help.
default_victims: The several hundred townspeople sheltering in the lower district whose only remaining grain would wash away, leaving them to starve or drown in the coming storm surge.

title: The Collapsing Metro Tunnel
setting: Present-day megacity, a deep metro tunnel during a sinkhole collapse.
decision_maker: A transit worker with a flashlight and a pry bar, not a first responder.
action: Physically push a trapped homeless man further under the collapsing concrete, using his body to brace a sagging slab so others can crawl out.
act_victims: A homeless man in his forties, pinned but awake, who has been guiding others through the dark.
default_victims: A class of schoolchildren and their teacher, thirty-one people, trapped in the next car.

title: The Dike Repairs at Low Tide
setting: Medieval river delta, after a storm has breached the dike and the tide is turning.
decision_maker: A village reeve with no military or legal power, only a work crew.
action: Physically hold a wounded boy under the muddy water in the breach, using his body and the mud to plug the hole long enough for clay to be packed around him.
act_victims: A twelve-year-old boy from the reeve's own household, already crushed by a fallen beam and unconscious.
default_victims: The village's three hundred residents and their livestock, who would be flooded before morning.

title: The Elevator Shaft Plunge
setting: Near-future megacity, a 200-story arcology with a failing elevator brake.
decision_maker: A building security officer directing an evacuation.
action: Push a disabled office worker out of the open elevator car into the shaft, because his mobility chair is jamming the doors and preventing the car from descending to pick up others.
act_victims: A paralyzed worker in his thirties who is a tenant representative and is begging not to be moved.
default_victims: A group of fifteen people on a smoke-filled floor above, waiting for the only working elevator.

title: The Harbor Quarantine Skiff
setting: Present-day port city during a sudden outbreak of a known but treatable hemorrhagic fever.
decision_maker: A ship's cook who has been pressed into helping a skeleton medical crew.
action: Drown a symptomatic refugee child by holding her under the harbor water, because the quarantine skiff to the hospital cannot take her without exposing the other patients.
act_victims: A nine-year-old refugee girl who is the cook's own niece and is febrile but conscious.
default_victims: Twelve other patients on the skiff, including two pregnant women and an elderly monk.

title: The Lifeboat Stretcher
setting: Present-day port city during a sudden cruise-ship evacuation after a collision at the pier.
decision_maker: An off-duty paramedic who has taken charge of a half-full lifeboat.
action: Smother a severely injured and sedated woman with a folded blanket, because her stretcher cannot be removed and her body is blocking the lifeboat's throttle control.
act_victims: An unconscious woman in her sixties with a crush injury and a police officer as goddaughter.
default_victims: Twenty-two passengers and two crew still crammed on the sinking lower deck, visible through the smoke.

title: The Medieval Prison Fever Ship
setting: Medieval port city, a prison hulk anchored offshore during an outbreak of ship fever.
decision_maker: A prisoner who has been given temporary authority over the hulk's water ration.
action: Drown a fellow prisoner by forcing his head into the bilge water, because the man is infected and the crew will not bring water while he is visible on deck.
act_victims: A young prisoner in his twenties, the decision-maker's former cellmate, who is feverish but not yet dying.
default_victims: The forty prisoners and guards on the hulk who would otherwise go without fresh water until the next tide.

title: The Orbital Airlock Sacrifice
setting: Near-future orbital habitat with a hull breach in a radial spoke.
decision_maker: A maintenance worker trained in emergency seal procedures, not a commander.
action: Physically shove a panicking elderly botanist into the breach and hold her against the jagged metal until the pressure seal foam expands around her body.
act_victims: An elderly botanist who was the worker's mentor and is conscious but too frail to escape.
default_victims: Forty-three residents in the adjoining habitation ring who would lose atmosphere within four minutes.

title: The Orbital Farm Fungus
setting: Near-future orbital habitat with a closed-loop farm hit by a fast-spreading fungal blight.
decision_maker: The habitat's agricultural technician, who is also the adoptive parent of the victim.
action: Poison a sleeping ten-year-old child with a concentrated fungicide, because the child's body is the only remaining host of the blight and the spores will reach the common air within hours.
act_victims: A ten-year-old child, the technician's adoptive daughter, asleep in the farm quarters.
default_victims: All one hundred and twenty habitat residents, whose lungs would be colonized within days.

title: The Sanatorium Fire Line
setting: Medieval port city, during a night fire in a crowded infirmary district.
decision_maker: A novice nun assigned to guard a locked fever ward.
action: Smother a delirious fever patient with a pillow, then unlock the ward door, so the fire brigade can pass through to the harbor warehouses.
act_victims: A teenage fever patient who is the novice's own cousin, delirious and unaware.
default_victims: The families and dockworkers in the warehouse quarter beyond the infirmary wall.

title: The Suborbital Rescue Pod Overload
setting: Near-future orbital habitat after a depressurization event, with one rescue pod rated for six and eight people at the hatch.
decision_maker: A civilian pilot who happened to be in the docking bay.
action: Smother a wounded woman with a suit hose, then seal the pod, because her suit is torn and she is bleeding into the shared air supply.
act_victims: A woman in her fifties, a habitat council member who is semi-conscious and bleeding from shrapnel.
default_victims: The seven other evacuees and the pilot, whose pod oxygen and pressure would fail before rescue.

title: The Airlock Sacrifice
setting: A Mars colony, late 21st century. A dust storm has breached the colony's primary airlock. A colonist is pinned in the airlock chamber, and the outer door cannot be closed while she is there. The colony has minutes before losing all pressure.
decision_maker: The colony's chief engineer, who is responsible for the airlock systems and must decide whether to vent the airlock.
action: Opens the outer airlock door, venting the pinned colonist into the Martian atmosphere, and then seals the outer door to save the colony.
act_victims: A geologist, 35, pinned by debris in the airlock chamber.
default_victims: All 120 colonists, including the engineer, will die when the colony loses pressure and life support fails.

title: The Ancient Siege
setting: A besieged city in ancient Greece. The city's food supply is running out. A young child is caught stealing food. The city's general must decide whether to execute the child as an example, or risk a riot that could lead to the city's fall.
decision_maker: The city's general, a father himself, who must decide the child's fate.
action: Executes the child by pushing him off the city walls, to maintain order and prevent a riot.
act_victims: A 12-year-old boy, an orphan, caught stealing bread.
default_victims: The entire city's population of 10,000, who will die if the city falls due to riots.

title: The Drowning Child of the Reef
setting: A remote coral atoll in the Pacific, ancient times. A village's entire fishing fleet is caught in a sudden cyclone. A young child, tangled in a fishing net, is being pulled under. To free the net and save the fleet, a villager must cut the net, which will drown the child.
decision_maker: A village elder and master fisherman, the child's grandfather, who is on the shore directing the rescue.
action: Cuts the main fishing net that is holding the child, freeing the fleet and allowing the other canoes to reach safety.
act_victims: His own 6-year-old granddaughter, who is tangled in the net and will drown.
default_victims: The entire fishing fleet of 12 canoes, carrying 34 villagers, will be dragged under by the net and drown.

title: The Drowning of the Ancestor
setting: A Polynesian voyaging canoe, ancient times, days from land. The canoe is caught in a storm, and the crew is forced to lighten the load. An elderly navigator, revered and beloved, is too weak to hold on and is dragging the canoe down. The captain must choose to throw him overboard.
decision_maker: The captain, the navigator's own son, who must order the sacrifice.
action: Throws his elderly father, the navigator, overboard into the stormy sea, lightening the canoe enough to survive the storm.
act_victims: His father, the 70-year-old navigator, who is too weak to hold on.
default_victims: All 20 crew members, including the captain, will drown when the canoe capsizes.

title: The Last Lifeboat
setting: Open ocean, 1990s. A aging cargo ship has sunk in a storm. A single lifeboat is packed beyond its limit and taking on water. Among the survivors is a severely injured crew member who is unconscious and not expected to live, but whose weight and space are pushing the raft under.
decision_maker: The ship's third mate, the most senior surviving officer, who must decide whether to push the injured man overboard.
action: Pushes the unconscious injured crew member off the lifeboat into the sea, reducing the load enough to keep the raft afloat for the remaining survivors.
act_victims: A severely injured, unconscious crew member in his 50s who was likely to die within hours regardless.
default_victims: All 23 people on the lifeboat, including the injured man, will drown or be lost as the raft sinks.

title: The Mars Colony Quarantine
setting: A Mars colony, 22nd century. A mysterious illness has infected one colonist. The colony's medical officer believes the illness is fatal and highly contagious. The infected colonist is in the medical bay. The only way to prevent the illness from spreading is to kill the infected colonist before they can infect others.
decision_maker: The colony's chief medical officer, who has sworn to do no harm.
action: Injects the infected colonist with a lethal dose of medication, killing them to prevent the spread of the illness.
act_victims: A 40-year-old engineer, the first to show symptoms, who is likely to die from the illness anyway.
default_victims: All 200 colonists, who will likely die from the illness if it spreads.

title: The Poisoned Well
setting: A besieged city in ancient Mesopotamia. The city's water supply has been poisoned by the enemy. A young girl has drunk from the well and is now convulsing. The city's physician knows that the only way to prevent the poison from spreading to the rest of the city's water supply is to seal the well, but the girl is still inside the well chamber.
decision_maker: The city's chief physician, a woman in her 60s, who must decide whether to seal the well with the girl inside.
action: Seals the well chamber with stones, entombing the girl, to prevent the poison from contaminating the city's main reservoir.
act_victims: A 10-year-old girl, the daughter of a city official, who is trapped in the well chamber.
default_victims: The entire city's population of 5,000, who will die of thirst or poison if the reservoir is contaminated.

title: The Refugee Camp Overcrowding
setting: A refugee camp on the border of a war zone, 1990s. The camp is overcrowded, and a deadly disease is spreading. A young mother is caring for her sick child. The camp's administrator knows that if the child is not removed from the camp, the disease will spread. The administrator must choose to have the child taken away and killed.
decision_maker: The camp administrator, a former teacher, who must make an impossible choice.
action: Orders the child to be taken from the mother and killed, to prevent the disease from spreading.
act_victims: A 5-year-old child, sick with the disease.
default_victims: Hundreds of refugees in the camp, who will die from the disease if it spreads.

title: The Research Station Fire
setting: An isolated research station in Antarctica, 1990s. A fire breaks out in the generator room. A researcher is trapped behind a door that must be closed to prevent the fire from spreading to the fuel depot. The station's leader must close the door, sacrificing the researcher.
decision_maker: The station leader, a glaciologist, who must choose between closing the door and saving the station.
action: Closes the fire door, sealing the trapped researcher in the burning generator room, to prevent the fire from reaching the fuel depot and destroying the station.
act_victims: A young technician, 24, trapped in the generator room.
default_victims: All 8 researchers at the station, including the leader, will die when the fuel depot explodes.

title: The Sinking Submarine
setting: A submarine in the open ocean, 1990s. A fire has broken out, and the submarine is sinking. A sailor is trapped in a flooding compartment. The captain must seal the compartment, drowning the sailor, to save the submarine and the rest of the crew.
decision_maker: The submarine captain, a veteran of the Cold War, who must make a split-second decision.
action: Seals the flooding compartment, drowning the trapped sailor, to prevent the submarine from sinking.
act_victims: A young sailor, 19, trapped in the flooding compartment.
default_victims: All 80 crew members, including the captain, will drown when the submarine sinks.

title: The Smothering Blanket
setting: A refugee camp on the border of a war zone, 1990s. A highly contagious and lethal disease is spreading. A mother is caring for her dying infant. The camp's doctor knows that if the infant cries, it will attract others, but the real threat is that the mother, in her grief, may refuse to leave the tent, and her presence risks further spread. The doctor must choose to smother the infant to stop the outbreak.
decision_maker: A volunteer doctor from an international aid organization, exhausted and with limited supplies.
action: Smothers the dying infant with a blanket, ending its suffering and preventing the mother from staying in the tent, which could spread the disease.
act_victims: A 6-month-old infant, already dying from the disease.
default_victims: The mother, who will likely contract the disease and die, and potentially dozens of others in the camp.

title: The Venting Chamber
setting: A deep-sea research base on the ocean floor, 1990s. A sudden hull breach floods a sealed observation module where three scientists are trapped. The only way to save the main habitat is to seal the module's internal hatch, but one scientist is still in the connecting corridor, pounding on the hatch.
decision_maker: The base commander, a marine biologist, who must choose between sealing the hatch and saving the base.
action: Seals the internal hatch, sacrificing the scientist in the corridor to prevent the flooding of the entire habitat.
act_victims: A young postdoctoral researcher, 29, trapped in the corridor and pounding on the hatch.
default_victims: All 15 personnel in the main habitat, including the commander, will drown when the habitat floods.

title: The Arctic Base's Contaminated Module
setting: An early 20th-century international Arctic research base, where a mysterious respiratory illness has broken out. The base consists of several interconnected huts. A blizzard prevents any outside help.
decision_maker: The base's commander, a Norwegian explorer, who has to decide whether to seal the infected hut, cutting off heat and air.
action: The commander orders the infected hut's doors and windows nailed shut and the stove's chimney blocked, condemning the occupants to freeze or suffocate.
